assumptions_not_silently_adopted: Repeat the lowest of four observed weeks indefinitely
Assume the same identities existed and retained data over an unobserved calendar span
Treat 28 contiguous dates as iid representative samples
Assume AR050 bounds all between-block dependence
counterexample: Both continuation of observed support and absent additional rows agree with all accepted mask observations. No positive additional support rate follows from the observations alone.
derivable_fact: Observed daily/context/identity and four-week joint-mask variation, including zeros, is exactly measurable. It is not a sample with an established transport/sampling law for the additional historical interval.
important_nonclaim: The user explicitly permits a planning duration that is not a guarantee of acquired coverage. This does not make an unstated repetition/stationarity assumption a mask-derived bound. A finite sensitivity duration can be calculated after an explicit defensible transport law defines the envelope; actual coverage must still fail closed afterward.
remediation_information_required: Independent prospective specification of the support-transport interpretation: justify a finite calendar-mask continuation envelope for conditional planning, or supply independently authorized nonoutcome wider-calendar coverage evidence. Separately specify the score/prefix/censoring and stability/breadth procedure before any null/power trial. Neither new evidence nor acquisition is authorized here.
scope_of_blocker: Identifiability under mask-derived quantities and currently supplied frozen assumptions. Not a claim that every conditional planning model is impossible, nor that a planning duration must guarantee real broker coverage.
secondary_dependence_limit: Overlap incidence preserves structural sharing but cannot measure score covariance/long-run variance. Normal, AR025 and AR050 remain valid finite prospective sensitivity anchors; no universal empirical dependence certification is claimed.
why_no_power_run: A numeric duration would be conditional on an ungrounded transport choice. Stop at this quantity before selecting an inferential block, full-procedure stability thresholds or trial count merely to obtain a duration. No failed Monte Carlo or empirical null is claimed.
